dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: This is the most famous painting in our gallery. Can you describe it?
dialogue.reading: ðɪs ɪz ðə ˈmoʊst ˈfeɪməs ˈpeɪntɪŋ ɪn aʊr ˈɡæləri. kən juː dɪˈskraɪb ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: There's a young woman sitting by a river, holding a pink lotus.
dialogue.reading: ðɛrz ə ˈjʌŋ ˈwʊmən ˈsɪtɪŋ baɪ ə ˈrɪvər, ˈhoʊldɪŋ ə ˈpɪŋk ˈloʊtəs.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good. And what can you see in the background?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. ənd ˈwʌt kən juː ˈsiː ɪn ðə ˈbækɡraʊnd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Two children playing in the water and an old man fishing from a boat.
dialogue.reading: ˈtuː ˈtʃɪldrən ˈpleɪɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈwɔːtər ənd ən ˈoʊld ˈmæn ˈfɪʃɪŋ frəm ə ˈboʊt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Very good. Notice the details, too. Can you see the bird sitting on the boat?
dialogue.reading: ˈvɛri ˈɡʊd. ˈnoʊtɪs ðə ˈdiːteɪlz, ˈtuː. kən juː ˈsiː ðə ˈbɜːrd ˈsɪtɪŋ ɑːn ðə ˈboʊt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, yes! It's so small. The artist painted every detail.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ˈjɛs! ɪts soʊ ˈsmɔːl. ði ˈɑːrtɪst ˈpeɪntɪd ˈɛvri ˈdiːteɪl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: The woman was the artist's daughter. She sat in that pose for weeks.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈwʊmən wʌz ði ˈɑːrtɪsts ˈdɔːtər. ʃiː ˈsæt ɪn ðæt ˈpoʊz fər ˈwiːks.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: For weeks? She must have been so tired!
dialogue.reading: fər ˈwiːks? ʃiː mʌst hæv bɪn soʊ ˈtaɪərd!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Probably! The artist made many sketches first. Some of them are in the next room.
dialogue.reading: ˈprɑːbəbli! ði ˈɑːrtɪst ˈmeɪd ˈmɛni ˈskɛtʃɪz ˈfɜːrst. sʌm əv ðɛm ər ɪn ðə ˈnɛkst ˈruːm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And this beautiful old frame? Is it original?
dialogue.reading: ənd ðɪs ˈbjuːtəfəl ˈoʊld ˈfreɪm? ɪz ɪt əˈrɪdʒənəl?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. The frame is more than a hundred years old, like the painting.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðə ˈfreɪm ɪz ˈmɔːr ðən ə ˈhʌndrəd ˈjɪrz ˈoʊld, ˈlaɪk ðə ˈpeɪntɪŋ.
